title: Naomi Cesar 'ready for anything' after qualifying for 800-m final at YOG
summary: Naomi Cesar advanced to the final of the women's 800 meters in athletics in the 4th Youth Olympics, finishing third in her heat at the Complexe Iba Mar Diop Stadium in Dakar, Senegal.
